retrievalProfile.description: A high-impact, text-only layout utilizing a vibrant red field with stacked, multi-weight sans-serif typography in yellow and black.
triggerTerms: red and yellow vintage album style
excludeWhen: delicate or ornate scripts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A saturated red background serves as the canvas for a hierarchical typographic stack. The top features ultra-bold, rounded yellow sans-serif characters, followed by a secondary tier of heavy black condensed grotesque type, and a tertiary block of white condensed sans-serif text organized into justified rows separated by bullets.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking between red, yellow, and black
Vertical hierarchy through varying font weights and scales
Justified text blocks creating a solid rectangular mass
Minimalist use of negative space to emphasize text density
coreInvariants: Absence of photographic or illustrative imagery
Center-aligned or fully justified text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text occupies 90% of the frame, scaled from largest at the top to smallest at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow title text in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-to-bottom vertical scan, moving from the boldest yellow to the dense white list at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight margins with minimal breathing room between text blocks to create a sense of urgency and presence.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright golden yellow for primary title
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors with high value contrast between yellow/white and the red base.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, yellow, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick strokes with slightly rounded terminals
Secondary text uses high-waisted, ultra-condensed vertical proportions
Tertiary text uses uniform stroke weights in a condensed block style
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'R' with a straight diagonal leg
Uppercase 'M' with a deep central valley
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast through weight and width; pairing a wide, heavy display face with an ultra-condensed secondary face.
graphicDevices: Bullet points (dots) used as separators in text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and presence of the primary title.
Captures the ultra-condensed feel of the secondary text.
Provides the clean, mid-century look for the tertiary list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, slightly textured matte red background with a subtle vintage paper grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply three levels of typography: a large yellow title at the top, a black condensed subtitle in the middle, and a white condensed list at the bottom separated by dots.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant red?
Are there three distinct colors of text (yellow, black, white)?
Is the layout purely typographic with no images?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame edges.
Verify the yellow is a warm golden hue, not neon.
Check that the black text is sufficiently condensed.
Confirm the background texture is subtle and doesn't distract from the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Red Field + [Bold Yellow Sans-Serif Title] + [Condensed Black Sans-Serif Subtitle] + [Justified White Condensed List with Bullets]
